Container.Name: flight-tracker
Container.Overview: Log flights, tag in-flight event times (gate push, takeoff, land, gate arrive) with one tap, keep timestamped notes, and visualize taxi times, delays, and air time. Works offline and syncs to your own Postgres.
Container.Description: A mobile-first flight log with a web dashboard. Tap to stamp gate push / takeoff / land / gate arrive (works offline and syncs when back online), log notes over time, and visualize derived metrics like taxi-out, taxi-in, air time, block time, and departure/arrival delays. Stores data in an external Postgres database via DATABASE_URL. On first run it seeds an initial set of flights if the database is empty.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Flight Tracker web app

Config.Name: Database SSL
Config.Description: Set to true if your Postgres requires SSL

Config.Name: Seed on empty
Config.Description: Seed initial flights on first run if the database is empty
